{{Vanilla|Diamond Ore}}
{{Infobox auto}}
'''Diamond ore''' is the ore that drops [[Raw Diamond|raw diamonds]]; the pack keeps its vanilla name.

The deepslate variant is '''deepslate diamond ore'''.

== Obtaining ==
=== Natural generation ===
As vanilla.

=== Breaking ===
Mined with a pickaxe (see [[Tools#Mining levels]]), it drops [[Raw Diamond|raw diamond]], affected by Fortune and electrum; adamant tools do not smelt it. Silk Touch drops the block.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/diamond_ore.json}}</ref>
